sample_3d_points_on_sphere: use fibonacci_sampling to generate evenly distributed 3D points on a sphere of a given radius
sample_camera_viewpoints: use sample_views to generate camera rotation and translation matrices from a view sphere
warp_image_between_cameras: use warp_image to remap a source image into the view of a destination camera model
warp_depth_between_cameras: use warp_depth_image to remap a depth image between two camera coordinate systems
convert_numpy_arrays_to_tensors: use arrays_to_tensors to recursively convert nested numpy arrays into PyTorch tensors
